### Summary

Robotics PhD candidate in Dr. Samuel Coogan's FACTS Lab at Georgia Tech and AI for Autonomy intern at Sandia National Laboratories. Specializes in safe autonomy, reinforcement learning, and real-time control. Proven track record of developing and deploying safe, computationally efficient planning and control methods for autonomous systems, with work published in leading peer-reviewed robotics and controls venues. Selected to the U.S. Department of State's Fulbright Specialist Roster after spearheading an international research collaboration with a Brazilian partner institution.
